## Summary

<!-- What does this change do, and why? -->

## Related issue

<!-- e.g. Closes #12, or "none" -->

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Packaging / CI
- [ ] Refactor / test-only change

## Verification

- [ ] `ruff check .`
- [ ] `ruff format --check .`
- [ ] `mypy src`
- [ ] `pytest -q`
- [ ] Tested with a real V4L2 camera, or explained why that was not possible
- [ ] If Hyprland rules/keybindings were documented or changed: `hyprctl reload` and `hyprctl configerrors` are clean

## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are focused with one-line conventional messages (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `chore:`, `ci:`, `test:`).
- [ ] README, `config.example.toml` and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated for user-facing changes.
- [ ] No unrelated refactors or changes to the working local Hyprland config/config tree.
